title: Body fat predicts exercise capacity in persons with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A machine learning approach.
summary: Machine-learning models on LOOK AHEAD participants estimate treadmill exercise capacity and identify body-fat measures as important predictors in adults with type 2 diabetes.
ai_technology: 1,348 patients; sex-stratified models and five-fold cross-validation; treadmill capacity is the measured outcome and body-composition features contribute predictive information. Association/prediction only; no causal or intervention claim.
